adoration.text: Adoration Room: weekday 07:00–22:00; weekend 07:00–20:00; public holiday 09:00–17:00; closed on Mondays 09:00–14:00 for cleaning; on first Mondays closed 09:00–16:00.

devotions.text: Rosary after weekday morning Eucharistic Celebrations.

good_to_know.text: Rosary is 40 minutes before weekend and weekday evening Eucharistic Celebrations.
